summary: Iteration 3 — Google Auth (Emergent) + 14-day Trial + Device Fingerprint anti-abuse. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASS via public ingress URL. /api/auth/google-session correctly returns 422 for missing/short session_token and 401 with detail='invalid_session_token' when a bogus 64-hex token is submitted (Emergent verify returns 404 → mapped to 401, observed in backend.err.log). /api/auth/me returns 401 'missing_token' for no header / non-Bearer header, 401 'invalid_token' for empty bearer, 401 'invalid_session' for bogus bearer. /api/auth/logout is idempotent (200 {ok:true}) with or without bogus token. All six new Mongo indexes are present at startup: users.email unique, users.user_id unique, users.device_fingerprint, user_sessions.session_token unique, user_sessions.expires_at TTL (expireAfterSeconds=0), user_sessions.user_id. Existing endpoints still healthy: /api/health, /api/, /api/parse-file (csv), /api/subscription/{id}, /api/admin/login wrong-creds. Frontend: /login renders correctly with title 'Rota+Rápida App', trial pill '14 dias grátis para testar', 4 feature cards (Lê PDF do Circuit / Scanner com voz / Sem precisar de mapa / R$ 20/mês após o trial) and 'Entrar com Google' button (testID=google-signin-button). Unauthenticated navigation to /, /upload, /scanner, /route, /paywall ALL redirect to /login as expected. /admin remains publicly accessible (Painel Admin screen renders) — admin uses its own JWT, untouched by the Google-auth guard. NOTE: real Google sign-in not attempted (requires full OAuth redirect — per request, fault paths only).

minor.issue: EXPO_BACKEND_URL key not set (only EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Backend tests fall back to it OK, but per the system-prompt PROTECTED_VARIABLES contract, EXPO_BACKEND_URL is the expected key — clients/test scripts that grep for it will miss. Consider mirroring as both.

issues: RN web warning repeated: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Affects login screen (logoCircle shadow*), index.tsx and paywall.tsx. Not a functional defect but adds console noise.

react_native_issues.issue: expo@54.0.34 (expected ~54.0.35), expo-font@14.0.11 (expected ~14.0.12), expo-router@6.0.23 (expected ~6.0.24). Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log. Same finding as iteration 2 — still not fixed.

action_items: LOW — Replace 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' on web (or restrict shadow props to native via Platform.select). Affected files: login.tsx (logoCircle, googleButton), index.tsx (logoCircle), paywall.tsx if any.

INFO — Device-fingerprint anti-abuse path (is_blocked_device=true) and the trial→paywall transition were NOT exercised end-to-end because real Google sign-in cannot be completed in CI. Recommend manual smoke test once on a real device: (1) first sign-in grants 14d trial, (2) sign-in with a different email on the SAME device returns user with is_blocked_device=true, (3) landing screen shows the 'Aparelho já usou o trial' blocked state and routes to /paywall. The /api/auth/me payload structure (trial_active, trial_days_remaining, is_blocked_device, subscription_active) is already validated by the Pydantic response model.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.py:35 — EMERGENT_SESSION_URL hardcoded; OK for Emergent-managed auth (no API key required) but consider env-overridable for future. Confirmed reachable from backend (httpx GET → 404 for bogus token, properly mapped to 401).
auth_routes.py:200 — device fingerprint blocking logic correctly creates a user with is_blocked_device=true and trial_started_at=None when fp_hash matches an existing user. Good.

auth_routes.py:226 — when an EXISTING user signs in, name/picture are refreshed from provider but device_fingerprint is only stored if NOT previously set. This means the SAME existing account can be unblocked-by-moving-to-a-new-device later (no fingerprint overwrite). Acceptable.
auth_routes.py:237 — session_token uses 64 hex chars from two uuid4() — strong enough.
server.py:1311 — register_auth_routes is called BEFORE app.include_router(api_router), so auth routes are correctly mounted under /api.
server.py:1344 — startup_event creates all six expected indexes; verified live in MongoDB.
_layout.tsx:25 — publicScreens=['login','admin'] — correctly bypasses Google-auth guard for /admin (which has its own JWT login). Verified in browser test.
auth.tsx:64 — exchangeEmergentSession does NOT pass an Authorization header to /api/auth/google-session (sends session_token in body) — matches backend contract. Good.

device.ts:32 — fallback UUID uses Math.random (non-crypto). For a fingerprint that is ALSO hashed with a server-side salt, this is acceptable, but the value is generated client-side and stored locally, so a user wiping local storage on web can simply get a new fingerprint and start a fresh trial. Known limitation per problem statement ("OK with reinstall limitation").
seed_data_creation: None — only read-only checks plus one bogus google-session attempt (no user inserted because Emergent verify returns 404 before any DB write).
